item.title: Team news: Plymouth v Stags
item.description: Nigel Clough makes three changes to the side that drew with Stevenage at the weekend. item.title: Orient match rearranged
item.description: Mansfield Town’s Sky Bet League One fixture away to Leyton Orient has been rearranged for Tuesday 14 April (7.45pm kick-off). The match, originally scheduled for Saturday 14 February, was postponed due to Stags’ progression in the Emirates FA Cup. Ticket details will be announced in due course.

item.title: Youth preview: Stags U18 v Burton U18
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s are aiming for three successive victories in the Youth Alliance League North on Saturday, as they go head-to-head with Burton Albion at RH Academy (11am kick-off). item.title: Stags sign new goalkeeper
item.description: Mansfield Town are delighted to announce the signing of experienced goalkeeper Harry Lewis from Carlisle United for an undisclosed fee. The 28-year-old has signed an 18-month contract at One Call Stadium. The 6ft 3in shot-stopper began his professional career at Southampton and made three Emirates FA Cup appearances for the Saints in 2017, keeping a clean sheet in a 1-0 third round replay win over Norwich City.
